tooth_algebra: Z/n with uniform Haar measure on SO(2) sampling (n teeth per 2pi)
slot_height_algebra: Z/n with non-uniform |sin theta|-weighted measure on SO(2) sampling (level crossings of floor(n (cos theta - eps + 1)/L))
verdict:
Same algebra (Z/n cyclic group), DIFFERENT representation on SO(2). Tooth-sampling is regular; slot-height-sampling is irregular (cos jacobian). When external rotation projects Z/n out:
  - tooth: equispaced impulses (delta train), Fourier = Dirichlet kernel
  - slot: irregularly-spaced impulses, Fourier picks up beats with cos(theta) structure.
Conceptually: gear-teeth are a STANDARD Z/n projection; slot-height-discrete is a Z/n projection 
PASSED THROUGH the s(theta) = cos(theta) - eps coordinate. The slot adds a layer of geometric 
obfuscation that tooth-counting does not.
Place under srmech notebook §3.5 (constraint-encoding manifold row): both are instances of 
fiber-as-spatially-absent encoding (Z/n algebra hidden in 1D coordinate), differing in 
the projection map from SO(2) to the discrete output.

note: Tooth lines concentrate at multiples of n (8, 16, 24...) per spec — Dirichlet kernel pattern. Slot lines redistribute due to cos(theta) jacobian — energy in low harmonics 1,2,3,4 from the cosine envelope, modulated by Z/8 quantization. Different REPRESENTATION same ALGEBRA.
